LIL/LIU forwarding: simulator forwards byte-loaded values, hardware has no forwarding path

Simulator: getFwdValFromEX() handles regLoadBYTELower/regLoadBYTEUpper cases, computing the correct byte-merged value.
Hardware: No forwarding mux for LIL/LIU results. Test programs use 3 NOPs after LIL blocks.

Simulator is MORE correct here — gives right results with or without NOPs. Hardware needs Phase 3 to add LIL/LIU forwarding paths. Reassess after HW Phase 3.
